paper_use_contracts.allowed_claim: Optical AGN hosts lie below BPT star-forming controls in catalog sSFR within this selected sample.
paper_use_contracts.forbidden_claim: Causal AGN feedback suppression or a complete quiescent-control result.
paper_use_contracts.required_selection_language: 60,000 cached rows out of 249,917 strict public four-line S/N>=3 rows; controls are star-forming emission-line galaxies, not all inactive/quiescent galaxies.
paper_use_contracts.safe_current_object: BPT optical AGN hosts versus star-forming controls in the capped SDSS four-line sample

paper_use_contracts.allowed_claim: High internal-density quartiles have a different low-sSFR fraction in the selected emission-line denominator.
paper_use_contracts.forbidden_claim: Environmental quenching causality or halo/group-scale proof.
paper_use_contracts.required_selection_language: Density quartiles are internal rankings after four-line selection; no group catalogue, halo mass, central/satellite label, or edge correction is present.
paper_use_contracts.safe_current_object: nearest-neighbour density proxy and low-sSFR fraction in the capped SDSS four-line sample

paper_use_contracts.allowed_claim: Defines optical AGN candidates for future maintenance-heating follow-up.
paper_use_contracts.forbidden_claim: Maintenance heating balance, duty-cycle energetics, or hot-halo feedback proof.
paper_use_contracts.required_selection_language: Massive/low-sSFR rows remain four-line emission-selected and capped; X-ray, cavity, cooling-luminosity, and jet-power data are absent.

paper_use_contracts.allowed_claim: Ranks/cuts optical AGN candidates for later outflow escape/recycling tests.
paper_use_contracts.forbidden_claim: Outflow escape fractions, recycling times, or gas-loss proof.
paper_use_contracts.required_selection_language: [O III]/H-beta high-excitation is an optical line-ratio proxy only; no velocities, escape speeds, CGM gas, or recycling tracers are measured.
paper_use_contracts.safe_current_object: high-excitation optical AGN denominator using bpt_label==agn and log_oiii_hb>0.25

paper_use_contracts.allowed_claim: Optical AGN/density association in massive hosts motivates radio/X-ray follow-up.
paper_use_contracts.forbidden_claim: Radio-jet coupling efficiency or environmental jet-power causality.
paper_use_contracts.required_selection_language: Massive-host cached sample is 9,298 rows versus 35,482 strict public S/N>=3 massive hosts; radio jet power, hot gas, and cavity data are absent.
paper_use_contracts.safe_current_object: massive-host optical BPT AGN fraction versus internal density proxy

paper_use_contracts.allowed_claim: Provides mass-bin optical/quenching diagnostics with intervals.
paper_use_contracts.forbidden_claim: Locating a physical transition from stellar to AGN feedback.
paper_use_contracts.required_selection_language: Mass bins are observed SDSS optical bins within a four-line selected denominator; no halo, black-hole mass, or stellar-feedback separation exists.
paper_use_contracts.safe_current_object: stellar-mass/redshift trends in low-sSFR and optical AGN incidence

paper_use_contracts.allowed_claim: Provides optical tracer thresholds and denominators for future multiphase matching.
paper_use_contracts.required_selection_language: Optical line/color/sSFR thresholds are not a multiphase census; CO/HI/Na I/X-ray/radio/kinematic data are absent.

paper_use_contracts.allowed_claim: Defines CO/HI/dust follow-up targets and line-selection attrition.
paper_use_contracts.forbidden_claim: Molecular gas depletion, gas fraction, depletion time, or star-formation efficiency conclusions.
paper_use_contracts.required_selection_language: Default massive/low-sSFR denominator: 121,533 public parent, 40,797 strict S/N>=3 rows, 10,270 cached rows; H-alpha is not gas mass or SFE.
paper_use_contracts.safe_current_object: emission-line-detected massive low-sSFR optical follow-up denominator

paper_use_contracts.allowed_claim: Provides a target vector for future forward-modelled simulation comparisons.
paper_use_contracts.forbidden_claim: Validation, rejection, ranking, or falsification of any feedback simulation.
paper_use_contracts.required_selection_language: The vector is observed-only; no mock catalog, simulation output, covariance model, or forward selection function has been compared.
paper_use_contracts.safe_current_object: observed SDSS mass-redshift target vector with small-cell flags
